title: Georgia
short description: Georgia has a land area of 57,716.8 square miles and a water area of 1,706.3 square miles. It is the 21st largest state by area.
description: Georgia has a land area of 57,716.8 square miles and a water area of 1,706.3 square miles. It is the 21st largest state by area. Georgia is bordered by North Carolina, South Carolina, Alabama, Florida, and Tennessee.
